goal: Understand everyday spoken Mandarin by ear, from clear learner videos up to real street interviews.

stages.name: Stage 1 · Listening toolkit
stages.why: Phrases that keep a Chinese speaker talking to you, slowly enough to follow.
stages.milestone: I followed a whole video in my zone without pausing.

phrases.gloss: zhège yòng Zhōngwén zěnme shuō? · How do you say this in Chinese?
zhè shì shénme yìsi? · What does this mean?
nǐ néng zài shuō yí biàn ma? · Can you say it again?
qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎn · Please speak a bit slower.
wǒ méi tīng dǒng · I didn't catch that.
ò, wǒ míngbai le! · Oh, I get it!

stages.name: Stage 2 · How people really talk
stages.why: Fillers and connectors fill real conversation. Once you hear them as filler, native speech gets much easier.
stages.milestone: I can hear 那个 and 就是 as filler in a street interview.

words.gloss: zěnme shuō ne · “how should I put it”

stages.name: Stage 3 · Topic playlists
stages.why: Narrow listening: the same vocabulary in many voices.
stages.milestone: I watched five videos on one topic in a week.
